title: Parsnip and Chestnut Festival Masala
tagline: Sweet parsnips, soft chestnuts, a proper garam masala hug.

ingredients.qty: 3 cloves garlic and 3cm root ginger, finely grated

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Toss half the cavolo nero with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt on a tray. Roast 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Set aside.
Warm the remaining 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan over a medium heat. Add the onions and a pinch of salt. Cook 12 minutes, stirring, until deep golden.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and garam masala for 1 minute. Add the parsnips, tomatoes, water and the remaining salt. Bring to a simmer.
Cover with the lid slightly ajar and simmer 20 minutes, until the parsnips are tender. Crush a few pieces against the pan to thicken the sauce.
Add the chestnuts, roughly broken up, and the remaining raw cavolo nero. Simmer 5 minutes until the leaves are soft. Taste and add salt if needed.
Spoon into bowls and pile the crisp cavolo nero on top just before serving, so it stays crunchy.
allergens: mustard or celery may be in some garam masala blends: check the label
